requirements.title: The owner's AI provider and key
requirements.rationale: Enrichment spends the owner's money and sends the owner's pages, so it runs only on a key they chose and entered.

criteria.condition: a user requests PUT /api/v1/settings/ai with provider 'anthropic' or 'openrouter', a non-empty api_key and, for OpenRouter, a model, and the provider accepts a test request made with that key and model
criteria.action: store the provider, the model (claude-opus-5-5 when an Anthropic model is not given) and the key encrypted, replacing any previous settings, and mark the key verified
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with body {configured: true, provider, model, key_last4, status: 'verified', rejected_message: null}

setup: the providers' endpoints answered by the fake AI provider of src/worker/test/ai.ts
check.pseudocode: in src/worker/enrich/keys.test.ts, a table over {anthropic, key 'sk-ant-abcd1234', no model: model 'claude-opus-5-5'; openrouter, key 'sk-or-wxyz', model 'meta/llama-4': that model}: r = api('PUT', '/api/v1/settings/ai', {body}); assert r.status == 200 and r.json == {configured: true, provider, model, key_last4: last 4 of the key, status: 'verified', rejected_message: null}; assert the fake provider received exactly one test request carrying the key and model

criteria.condition: the provider rejects the test request made with the submitted key
criteria.action: refuse to store the key, keeping any previous settings unchanged
criteria.contract: HTTP 400 with body {"error": "key_rejected", "field": "api_key", "message": <the provider's error message>}; GET /api/v1/settings/ai returns what it returned before

check.pseudocode: in src/worker/enrich/keys.test.ts, a table over {no previous key; a previous verified key}: the fake provider answers 401 {error: {message: 'invalid x-api-key'}}; r = PUT a new key; assert 400, error 'key_rejected', field 'api_key', message 'invalid x-api-key'; assert GET settings equals its earlier body

criteria.condition: PUT /api/v1/settings/ai names a provider other than 'anthropic' or 'openrouter', has an empty or missing api_key, names OpenRouter without a model, or has a model longer than 200 characters
criteria.action: refuse the request without calling a provider and without storing anything
criteria.contract: HTTP 400 with body {"error": "invalid_provider" | "invalid_key" | "model_required" | "invalid_model", "field", "message"}; the fake provider received no request

check.pseudocode: in src/worker/enrich/keys.test.ts, a table over {provider 'workers-ai': invalid_provider/provider; api_key '': invalid_key/api_key; no api_key: invalid_key/api_key; openrouter without model: model_required/model; model of 201 characters: invalid_model/model}: assert 400 with error and field; assert the fake provider's request log is empty and settings unchanged

criteria.condition: the provider cannot be reached for the test request, answers with a 5xx status, or does not answer within 60 seconds
criteria.action: refuse to store the key and say the provider is unavailable
criteria.contract: HTTP 502 with body {"error": "provider_unavailable", "message": <text>}; settings unchanged

check.pseudocode: in src/worker/enrich/keys.test.ts, a table over the fake provider {refusing connections; answering 529 overloaded; stalling past a 200 ms test timeout}: r = PUT; assert 502 and error 'provider_unavailable'; assert settings unchanged

criteria.condition: a user requests GET /api/v1/settings/ai
criteria.action: return the stored provider, model, the key's last 4 characters, the key's status with the provider's rejection message when rejected, and the number of the user's links waiting to be enriched
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with body {configured: true, provider, model, key_last4, status: 'verified' | 'rejected', rejected_message, unenriched_count} or {configured: false, unenriched_count}

check.pseudocode: in src/worker/enrich/keys.test.ts, a table over {no key and 2 links with enrichment_status 'no_key': {configured: false, unenriched_count: 2}; a verified key: configured true with key_last4; a key marked rejected with 'credit balance too low': status 'rejected' and that message}: assert GET /api/v1/settings/ai body

criteria.condition: a user requests DELETE /api/v1/settings/ai
criteria.action: remove the stored provider, model and key, so that later links are not enriched
criteria.contract: HTTP 204; GET /api/v1/settings/ai then returns configured false; a link fetched afterwards gets enrichment_status 'no_key'

check.pseudocode: in src/worker/enrich/keys.test.ts: save a key; assert DELETE answers 204; assert GET returns configured false and no ciphertext column is set; add a link and process its fetch; assert enrichment_status 'no_key' and the fake provider received no enrichment request

criteria.action: for any stored key, keep it only encrypted with AES-GCM under KEY_ENCRYPTION_KEY with the user's id bound as additional data, and never return the key, or any part of it beyond its last 4 characters, in any API response

check.pseudocode: in src/worker/enrich/keys.test.ts: save key 'sk-ant-secret-abcd1234'; assert no D1 value contains 'sk-ant-secret' or the whole key; assert decryptKey(ciphertext, iv, userId) == the key and decryptKey(ciphertext, iv, otherUserId) throws; and an afterAll hook over every response the shared api() helper recorded in the worker test run asserts that no body or header contains a saved test key

criteria.condition: the owner saves, replaces or removes the AI key on the settings page
criteria.action: offer the provider choice with Anthropic preselected, the key and model inputs, show 'key verified' on success, the provider's message on a rejection, the stored key only as its last 4 characters, and Replace and Remove actions
criteria.contract: after a successful save the page reads 'key verified' and '…1234'; on key_rejected it shows the provider's message; the key input is empty after any save

check.pseudocode: in src/web/pages/Settings.test.tsx with a fake API: assert the provider select defaults to Anthropic and the model placeholder is 'claude-opus-5-5'; choose OpenRouter and assert the model input is required; save and assert 'key verified' and '…1234' and an empty key input; with the fake answering key_rejected assert its message is shown; click Remove and assert DELETE /api/v1/settings/ai

requirements.title: Enriching a fetched link
requirements.rationale: A summary, a few tags and one topic per link are what make a large library browsable at a glance.

criteria.condition: a fetch or refresh makes a link 'active' with reader-view text or a title, and its user has a verified key
criteria.action: send an enrichment message for the link from the fetch worker, then call the user's provider with the user's key and model and store the summary, tags, topic and enrichment time on the link
criteria.contract: GET /api/v1/links/{id} returns enrichment_status 'enriched', summary, tags: [string] (3 to 8), topic: string and enriched_at

check.pseudocode: in src/worker/enrich/enrich.test.ts: save a key; the fake origin serves an article; add the link; process its fetch message, then the recorded ENRICH_QUEUE message, with the fake provider answering {summary: 'A short summary.', tags: ['cloudflare', 'queues', 'workers'], topic: 'web development'}; assert the link's enrichment_status 'enriched' and the three fields

criteria.action: for any enrichment request, send the provider only the instructions, the link's title and host, the user's existing topic and tag names, and the first 20,000 characters of the reader-view text, or the title and description when the reader view is empty; never the raw HTML, cookies, or the user's email, name or id

check.pseudocode: in src/worker/enrich/enrich.test.ts, a table over {an article whose reader text is 30,000 characters: the request holds exactly its first 20,000; a page with an empty reader view: the request holds the title and description and no page text}: enrich; take the fake provider's captured request body; assert the text part; assert it contains none of the snapshot's '<html', the owner's email, name or user id, and no cookie header was sent

criteria.action: for any tag or topic name returned by the provider, reuse the user's existing tag or topic whose name is equal ignoring case with spaces read as hyphens, and create a new one only when none is, listing the user's 100 most used topics and 300 most used tags in the request

check.pseudocode: in src/worker/enrich/enrich.test.ts, a table of (existing vocabulary, returned names, stored names, new rows): ({tag 'web-dev'}, ['Web Dev'], ['web-dev'], 0); ({topic 'Programming'}, topic 'programming', 'Programming', 0); ({}, ['rust'], ['rust'], 1); and with 400 existing tags assert the captured request lists exactly the 300 most used

criteria.action: for any provider result, lower-case the tags, turn spaces into hyphens, drop characters other than a-z, 0-9 and '-', drop empty and repeated tags, keep the first 8, and cut the summary to its first 60 words

check.pseudocode: in src/worker/enrich/enrich.test.ts, a table over normalizeResult inputs: tags ['Rust', 'rust', 'Web Assembly', 'C++', '', 'a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e', 'f'] -> ['rust', 'web-assembly', 'c', 'a', 'b', 'd', 'e', 'f']; a summary of 75 words -> its first 60 words; a summary of 60 words -> unchanged

criteria.condition: a link is noted 'not a web page', 'no text in this PDF' or 'PDF too large to store (50 MB limit)'
criteria.action: send no enrichment message and call no provider for it
criteria.contract: the link's enrichment_status is 'skipped'; no ENRICH_QUEUE message and no provider request

check.pseudocode: in src/worker/enrich/enrich.test.ts, a table over the three notes, produced through the fake origin (an image, a scanned PDF, a 60 MB PDF), with a verified key: process the fetch; assert enrichment_status 'skipped', no recorded ENRICH_QUEUE message and an empty fake-provider log

criteria.action: for any user, call the provider only with that user's own key and model, and never with another user's key or a deployment-wide key

check.pseudocode: in src/worker/enrich/enrich.test.ts: user A saves anthropic key kA, user B saves openrouter key kB with model mB; each adds a link; process all messages; assert the fake provider saw kA only on Anthropic requests for A's link and kB with mB only on OpenRouter requests for B's link

criteria.action: for any change of provider, model or key, leave the summary, tags and topic of already enriched links unchanged and send no enrichment for them

check.pseudocode: in src/worker/enrich/enrich.test.ts: enrich a link; PUT a different provider and model; assert no ENRICH_QUEUE message was recorded and the link's summary, tags, topic and enriched_at are unchanged

criteria.action: for either provider, ask for the result as structured data, a forced tool call through the Anthropic Messages API or a JSON-schema response format through OpenRouter's chat completions, and read summary, tags and topic from it

check.pseudocode: in src/worker/enrich/providers.test.ts, a table over {anthropic: the fake answers a tool_use block with input {summary, tags, topic}; openrouter: the fake answers a message whose content is that JSON}: r = enrichWith(provider, key, model, request); assert r == {summary, tags, topic}; assert the captured request named the model and carried tool_choice for Anthropic or response_format json_schema for OpenRouter

requirements.title: Working without a key
requirements.rationale: The library must be fully usable before, and without, any AI provider.

criteria.condition: a user has no stored AI key
criteria.action: fetch and snapshot the user's links as normal and mark each fetched link as not enriched for want of a key, without sending enrichment messages
criteria.contract: the link is 'active' with its snapshot, enrichment_status 'no_key', no summary, tags or topic; no ENRICH_QUEUE message

check.pseudocode: in src/worker/enrich/enrich.test.ts: with no key, add a link and process its fetch; assert state 'active', the snapshot present, enrichment_status 'no_key', summary null, tags [] and no recorded ENRICH_QUEUE message

criteria.condition: the owner has no stored key and at least one link with enrichment_status 'no_key'
criteria.action: show 'not enriched: add an AI key in settings' once as a banner above the stream, linking to the settings page, and nothing about it on the cards
criteria.contract: exactly one banner with that text and a link to /settings; no card carries the text

check.pseudocode: in src/web/pages/Stream.test.tsx with a fake API, a table over {no key, unenriched_count 3: one banner; no key, unenriched_count 0: no banner; a verified key, unenriched_count 3: no banner}: renderPage('/'); assert the banner count and that no card contains 'add an AI key'

criteria.condition: a user with a verified key requests POST /api/v1/links/enrich-unenriched
criteria.action: schedule every one of the user's links whose enrichment_status is 'no_key', 'waiting_for_key' or 'failed' through the background throttle and mark them queued
criteria.contract: HTTP 202 with body {queued: n}; each of the n links has enrichment_status 'queued' and one ENRICH_QUEUE message whose delay comes from the throttle

check.pseudocode: in src/worker/enrich/enrich.test.ts: seed 25 links with 'no_key', 2 'failed', 1 'enriched' and 1 'skipped'; save a key; r = api('POST', '/api/v1/links/enrich-unenriched'); assert 202 {queued: 27}; assert 27 recorded messages with delaySeconds 0, 3, 6, ... 78 and the enriched and skipped links untouched

criteria.condition: POST /api/v1/links/enrich-unenriched is requested by a user with no stored key or with a key marked rejected
criteria.action: refuse the request and schedule nothing
criteria.contract: HTTP 409 with body {"error": "no_ai_key", "message": "add an AI key in settings"}; no ENRICH_QUEUE message

check.pseudocode: in src/worker/enrich/enrich.test.ts, a table over {no key; a rejected key}: r = POST enrich-unenriched; assert 409 and the body; assert no recorded message

criteria.condition: the owner has a verified key and links waiting to be enriched
criteria.action: offer 'enrich all unenriched links' with their number on the settings page, and report how many were queued when chosen
criteria.contract: a button 'Enrich all unenriched links (n)'; after the click the page reads 'queued n links'

check.pseudocode: in src/web/pages/Settings.test.tsx with a fake API answering unenriched_count 27: assert the button text; click; assert one POST /api/v1/links/enrich-unenriched and 'queued 27 links'; with unenriched_count 0 assert no button

requirements.title: The background throttle
requirements.rationale: A large import or an 'enrich all' must not flood the provider, the owner's bill or the origin sites.

criteria.action: for any job scheduled through the throttle for a user, give it a start time 3 seconds after that user's previous scheduled start, or the scheduling time when that slot has already passed

check.pseudocode: in src/worker/enrich/throttle.test.ts: setNow(t); slots = scheduleThrottled(user, 600 jobs); assert slots[i] == t + 3 i seconds, so the last is t + 1797 s (under 30 minutes); setNow(t + 3 hours); assert the next scheduled slot == t + 3 hours

criteria.action: for any sequence of throttled scheduling calls for one user at any times, start at most 20 of the user's jobs in any 60-second window

check.pseudocode: in src/worker/enrich/throttle.test.ts: for random sequences of (time offset, batch size up to 200) calls: collect all slots; for every slot s assert count(slots in [s, s + 60 s)) <= 20 and every slot >= its call's time

criteria.action: for any two users, schedule their throttled jobs independently, so that one user's queued jobs never delay another user's

check.pseudocode: in src/worker/enrich/throttle.test.ts: schedule 600 jobs for A at t; schedule 1 job for B at t; assert B's slot == t

criteria.condition: a job's slot is more than 12 hours after the time its message is sent
criteria.action: send the message with the queue's longest delay of 12 hours and, on its arrival before the slot, send it again for the time left instead of processing it
criteria.contract: the first send carries delaySeconds 43200; a message arriving before its slot is re-sent with delaySeconds = slot - now and not processed; a message arriving at or after its slot is processed

check.pseudocode: in src/worker/enrich/throttle.test.ts: give a job a slot t + 14 h; assert the recorded send has delaySeconds 43200; deliver it at t + 12 h; assert it is re-sent with delaySeconds 7200 and the provider was not called; deliver it at t + 14 h; assert it is processed

requirements.title: Enrichment failures and re-runs
requirements.rationale: Providers fail and models refuse; the link must stay useful and the owner must be able to try again.

criteria.condition: the first automatic enrichment attempt of a link fails by a provider error other than a rejected key, a rate limit, a refusal, no answer within 60 seconds, or a result that is invalid after normalisation
criteria.action: keep the link 'active' with its fetched title and description and no summary, tags or topic, mark it failed with the reason, and send the enrichment message again with a delay of 10 minutes
criteria.contract: enrichment_status 'failed', enrichment_reason set, summary null, tags []; one ENRICH_QUEUE message re-sent with delaySeconds 600

check.pseudocode: in src/worker/enrich/enrich.test.ts, a table over the fake provider's answers {500; 429 with retry-after; a stop_reason 'refusal'; a stall past the test timeout; a result with 2 tags}: process the enrichment message; assert state 'active', the fetched title, enrichment_status 'failed', a reason, and one re-sent message with delaySeconds 600

criteria.condition: the automatic retry of a link's enrichment fails as well
criteria.action: leave the link failed and send no further automatic retry
criteria.contract: enrichment_status 'failed'; no ENRICH_QUEUE message sent

check.pseudocode: in src/worker/enrich/enrich.test.ts beside the test above: process the re-sent message with the fake still answering 500; assert enrichment_status 'failed' and no message recorded

criteria.condition: a user with a verified key requests POST /api/v1/links/{id}/enrich for one of their links that has reader-view text or a title to enrich
criteria.action: send an enrichment message for the link at once, outside the throttle, and mark it queued
criteria.contract: HTTP 202 with body {status: 'queued'}; one ENRICH_QUEUE message with no delay; a later success stores the result as an automatic enrichment does

check.pseudocode: in src/worker/enrich/enrich.test.ts: make a link 'failed'; the fake provider recovers; r = api('POST', '/api/v1/links/' + id + '/enrich'); assert 202 {status: 'queued'} and one message without delay; process it; assert enrichment_status 'enriched'

criteria.condition: POST /api/v1/links/{id}/enrich is requested without a verified key, or for a link that is 'pending', 'unreachable' or 'skipped'
criteria.action: refuse the request and send nothing
criteria.contract: HTTP 409 with body {"error": "no_ai_key", "message": "add an AI key in settings"} without a verified key, or {"error": "nothing_to_enrich", "message": <text>} for such a link; no ENRICH_QUEUE message

check.pseudocode: in src/worker/enrich/enrich.test.ts, a table over {no key: no_ai_key; a 'pending' link: nothing_to_enrich; an 'unreachable' link: nothing_to_enrich; a 'skipped' PDF: nothing_to_enrich}: assert 409, the error code and no recorded message

criteria.condition: the stream or detail page shows a link whose enrichment_status is 'failed'
criteria.action: say 'enrichment failed' on its card with a 're-run enrichment' action that sends the enrich request
criteria.contract: the card reads 'enrichment failed' and the action sends POST /api/v1/links/{id}/enrich, after which the card shows the queued state

check.pseudocode: in src/web/components/LinkCard.test.tsx with a fake API: render a failed link; assert 'enrichment failed' and the 're-run enrichment' action; click it; assert one POST .../enrich and a queued indicator

requirements.title: A key the provider starts rejecting
requirements.rationale: A revoked or exhausted key must be reported once and stop the spending of failed requests, not fail every link one by one.

criteria.condition: the provider answers an enrichment request with HTTP 401, 402 or 403
criteria.action: mark the user's key rejected with the provider's message, pause the user's enrichment, and leave the link waiting for a key without counting a failed attempt or retrying
criteria.contract: GET /api/v1/settings/ai returns status 'rejected' and rejected_message equal to the provider's message; the link's enrichment_status is 'waiting_for_key'; no ENRICH_QUEUE message is re-sent

check.pseudocode: in src/worker/enrich/enrich.test.ts, a table over the fake provider's {401 'invalid x-api-key'; 402 'insufficient credits'; 403 'permission denied'}: process an enrichment message; assert the settings status and message, the link's 'waiting_for_key' and no re-sent message

criteria.condition: the user's key is marked rejected
criteria.action: mark every link of the user that reaches enrichment as waiting for a key without calling the provider
criteria.contract: such links get enrichment_status 'waiting_for_key'; the fake provider receives no request

check.pseudocode: in src/worker/enrich/enrich.test.ts: mark the key rejected; add two links and process their fetch and enrichment messages; assert both 'waiting_for_key' and an empty fake-provider log

criteria.condition: the user saves a key that the provider accepts while the previous key is marked rejected
criteria.action: replace the key and lift the pause, leaving the waiting links waiting until the owner chooses 'enrich all unenriched links'
criteria.contract: GET /api/v1/settings/ai returns status 'verified' and rejected_message null; links added afterwards are enriched; waiting links keep 'waiting_for_key' and are counted in unenriched_count

check.pseudocode: in src/worker/enrich/enrich.test.ts: with a rejected key and one waiting link, PUT a key the fake accepts; assert status 'verified'; add a new link and assert it ends 'enriched'; assert the waiting link is still 'waiting_for_key' and unenriched_count == 1

criteria.condition: the owner's key is marked rejected
criteria.action: show 'your AI key was rejected: <provider message>' once at the top of the settings page, beside the Replace and Remove actions, until the key is replaced or removed
criteria.contract: the settings page shows the message exactly once; no card carries it

check.pseudocode: in src/web/pages/Settings.test.tsx with a fake API answering status 'rejected' and 'insufficient credits': assert 'your AI key was rejected: insufficient credits' appears once; with status 'verified' assert it is absent; in src/web/pages/Stream.test.tsx assert no card shows it

requirements.title: Manual edits win
requirements.rationale: The owner's own words about a link are worth more than any model's, and must never be silently undone.

criteria.condition: a user requests PATCH /api/v1/links/{id} for one of their links with any of title, summary, tags and topic, each valid
criteria.action: store the given fields and record each of them as edited
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with body <link> carrying the new values and edited_fields listing the given fields together with those edited before

check.pseudocode: in src/worker/enrich/edits.test.ts: r = api('PATCH', '/api/v1/links/' + id, {body: {tags: ['Reading List', 'rust'], topic: 'Programming'}}); assert 200, tags == ['reading-list', 'rust'], topic 'Programming' and edited_fields == ['tags', 'topic']; PATCH {title: 'My title'}; assert edited_fields == ['tags', 'topic', 'title']

criteria.action: for any field a user has edited, leave it unchanged through every later automatic enrichment, re-run enrichment and refresh, while still updating the fields not edited

check.pseudocode: in src/worker/enrich/edits.test.ts, a table over edited field {title, summary, tags, topic} crossed with {automatic enrichment after a refresh, POST .../enrich}: edit the field; the fake origin and fake provider now answer different values; run the operation through its messages; assert the edited field keeps the owner's value and the other three fields took the new automatic values

criteria.condition: PATCH /api/v1/links/{id} carries a title that is empty or longer than 500 characters, a summary longer than 2,000 characters, tags that are not a list of at most 20 names each non-empty after normalisation, or a topic that is empty or longer than 100 characters
criteria.action: refuse the whole request and change nothing
criteria.contract: HTTP 400 with body {"error": "invalid_title" | "invalid_summary" | "invalid_tags" | "invalid_topic", "field", "message"}; the link and its edited_fields are unchanged

check.pseudocode: in src/worker/enrich/edits.test.ts, a table over bodies {title '': invalid_title; title of 501 chars: invalid_title; summary of 2,001 chars: invalid_summary; tags 'rust': invalid_tags; 21 tags: invalid_tags; tags ['++']: invalid_tags; topic '': invalid_topic; topic of 101 chars: invalid_topic; {title: 'ok', topic: ''}: invalid_topic}: assert 400, error, field; assert the link unchanged

criteria.action: for any edited tag or topic name, normalise it as provider tags are normalised and reuse the user's existing tag or topic of the same name ignoring case, creating one only when none exists

check.pseudocode: in src/worker/enrich/edits.test.ts, a table of (existing vocabulary, edit, stored, new rows): ({tag 'web-dev'}, tags ['Web Dev'], ['web-dev'], 0); ({topic 'Programming'}, topic 'PROGRAMMING', 'Programming', 0); ({}, tags ['zig'], ['zig'], 1): PATCH; assert stored names and the count of new tag or topic rows

criteria.condition: the owner edits title, summary, tags or topic on a link's detail page
criteria.action: offer in-place editing of the four fields, send only the changed fields, show the saved values and mark edited fields as set by the owner
criteria.contract: one PATCH /api/v1/links/{id} carrying only the changed fields; each edited field shows an 'edited' marker; a 400 shows its message beside the field

check.pseudocode: in src/web/pages/LinkDetail.test.tsx with a fake API: edit the topic and save; assert one PATCH with body {topic: 'Rust'} only; assert the topic shows 'Rust' with an 'edited' marker; with the fake answering 400 invalid_topic assert the message is shown beside the topic

requirements.title: Showing summary, tags and topic
requirements.rationale: Enrichment is only worth its cost if the owner sees it where they browse.

criteria.condition: a client reads a link through GET /api/v1/links, GET /api/v1/links/{id} or the change feed
criteria.action: include the link's summary, tags, topic, enrichment status, enrichment reason and edited fields
criteria.contract: every link object carries summary: string | null, tags: [string], topic: string | null, enrichment_status, enrichment_reason: string | null, edited_fields: [string]

check.pseudocode: in src/worker/enrich/enrich.test.ts: enrich a link; for each of GET /api/v1/links, GET /api/v1/links/{id} and GET /api/v1/links?changed_since=t0 assert the link object carries the six fields with the enriched values

criteria.condition: the stream shows an enriched link
criteria.action: show its summary in two lines that expand on request, its tags and its topic
criteria.contract: the card shows the summary clamped to two lines with a 'more' control that expands it, one chip per tag and the topic

check.pseudocode: in src/web/components/LinkCard.test.tsx: render a link with a 60-word summary, tags ['rust', 'wasm', 'performance'] and topic 'Programming'; assert the summary element is clamped to two lines, clicking 'more' removes the clamp, three tag chips and the topic are shown

criteria.condition: the stream page holds a card whose enrichment_status is 'queued', or whose link is pending with a verified key
criteria.action: keep asking for changed links every 5 seconds, so that summary, tags and topic appear on the card without a reload
criteria.contract: changed_since requests continue while such a card remains; the card shows the summary once the feed returns it; requests stop when none remains

check.pseudocode: in src/web/pages/Stream.test.tsx with fake timers: render an 'active' card with enrichment_status 'queued'; advance 5 s; assert one changed_since request; the fake returns it 'enriched' with a summary; assert the summary on the same card; advance 15 s; assert no further request

execution_paths.title: The owner adds a key and a pasted link is enriched within a minute

steps.action: chooses Anthropic on the settings page, enters an API key and saves
sends a test request with the key to the AI provider
accepts the test request
stores the key encrypted and answers verified
shows 'key verified' and the key's last 4 characters
pastes 'https://example.com/article?utm_source=x' and presses Enter
fetches the page, stores its snapshot and reader view, sets the link 'active' and sends an enrichment message
sends the reader text and the vocabulary to the AI provider with the owner's key and model
returns a summary, tags and a topic
normalises the result, reuses or creates tags and the topic, and stores them on the link
shows the title, summary, tags and topic on the card without a reload

setup: wrangler dev with local bindings and KEY_ENCRYPTION_KEY set

ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL points at e2e/fake-ai.ts, which accepts the key 'sk-ant-test-1234' and answers enrichment with a fixed summary, tags and topic; ORIGIN_PROXY_URL points at e2e/fake-origin.ts playing https://example.com/article (the provider and the origin are the only stubbed parties besides e2e/fake-google.ts)
the owner signed in with no key
end_state: the settings page showed 'key verified' and '…1234'
within 60 seconds of Enter, without a reload, the card shows the fetched title, the fake's summary, its tags and its topic
the users row holds no plaintext key; the fake provider received the key only in its authentication header
the fake provider's enrichment request contained the article text and not the owner's email
